title: A long document with the gaps visible
description: The original and the translation are saved page by page, and the parts left unprocessed are easy to find.

blocks.text: The first paragraphs appearing gives the impression that it is done. A table, a scan or the end of the file may be left untranslated.

quote.text: Tried to upload a PDF from Files. Could not find a means by which to upload any documents from anywhere in the known universe. It was the primary reason I downloaded it. I will be deleting it now. Only Clippy was less useful.

blocks.text: Before the start, show the limits on volume and format. After processing, give an overview of the pages and the gaps, and a way to jump to the original passage.
Important names, numbers and wordings have to be checked. A preserved structure helps in reading the document, but does not confirm that its content is accurate.
